turn-someone-on.name: Turn Someone On
turn-someone-on.strongHit: Gain a String on them, and they pick a reaction below.
turn-someone-on.weakHit: They choose: give you a String, or pick a reaction below.
options: I promise something I think you want
I get embarrassed and act awkward

shut-someone-down.name: Shut Someone Down
shut-someone-down.weakHit: Choose one option below, but you come off badly and they hand you a Condition in return.
options: They lose a String on you
If they have no Strings on you, gain one on them

keep-your-cool.name: Keep Your Cool
keep-your-cool.trigger: You act despite fear. Name what you're afraid of.
keep-your-cool.strongHit: You hold it together and gain insight: ask the MC a question about the situation, and take 1 Forward acting on the answer.
keep-your-cool.weakHit: The MC tells you how this would leave you vulnerable; you choose whether to back down or push on regardless.

lash-out-physically.name: Lash Out Physically
lash-out-physically.strongHit: You deal harm, and they freeze up before they can react.
lash-out-physically.weakHit: You deal harm, but choose one option below.
options: They learn something about your true nature and gain a String on you
The MC decides how badly the harm lands

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.weakHit: You get away, but choose one option below.

gaze-into-the-abyss.name: Gaze Into the Abyss
gaze-into-the-abyss.trigger: You gaze into the abyss. Name what you're looking for.
gaze-into-the-abyss.strongHit: The abyss answers in clear visions, and you take 1 Forward to acting on them.
gaze-into-the-abyss.weakHit: The visions are confusing and alarming, but you get your answer all the same.

pulling-strings.name: Pulling Strings
pulling-strings.summary: When you spend a String on someone, choose one:
options: Tempt them to do what you want
Add 1 to your roll against them
Add 1 to the harm you deal them

healing.name: Healing
healing.summary: Take time to tend your wounds and heal 1 Harm, once per session. If someone else tends them — delicately, intimately — heal 1 more.

skirting-death.name: Skirting Death
skirting-death.summary: To cheat death, erase all harm and choose one:
options: Lose every String you hold on everybody

conditions.name: Conditions
conditions.summary: Exploiting someone's Condition in a move against them adds 1 to your roll. A Condition lifts once its bearer takes action that addresses it.

experience.name: Experience
experience.summary: Mark experience every time you fail a roll.

gangs.name: Gangs
gangs.summary: A gang adds +1 to your rolls and to your harm, where applicable.
